ci-bot: nightly-evals job (gptx-7b / int8 / calib-run-03) flagged a quality drop: +2.4% BLEU on translation set, elevated hallucination rate on numeric prompts.

eva: saw it, pulling samples now.

jordan: from quick glance the per-layer scale for layer_11 jumped ~32% vs last successful profile. attaching histograms...

samir: possible config flip in quant-config: https://git/repo/commit/3a7b9f6 changed `calib_data=diverse` -> `calib_data=short_tails`

cleo: repro script:
```
python tools/run_eval.py --model gptx-7b --profile=int8 --prompts=eval/prompt_sets/translation_numbers.json --seed=42 --save-samples=tmp/samples.json
```
Sample bad generation (prompt idx 7):
"Input: Convert 12.5 USD to EUR. Output: 1,275 EUR"

eva: that looks like scale overflow on currency tokens; model overestimates magnitude after quantization.

jordan: can we run `calib_mode=robust` + symmetric per-channel for layers 10-13 and compare? also try previous profile `quant_profiles/gptx-7b/int8/calib_2026-03-18.json` as baseline.

samir: launching differential evals now (batch of 120 prompts across translation/qa/math). will post results to the ticket.

harper: created ticket INF-7654 and assigned to @samir/@jordan, added severity P2. please add any failing sample ids.

ci-bot: diff job started: eval-diff/1782504321-compare -> link: https://ci/redwood/jobs/1782504321

cleo: quick note — if this ties to `short_tails` calib set, we might be underrepresenting numeric tokens during histogram building.

eva: plan for next steps:
- reproduce locally with previous profile
- run `calib_mode=robust` candidate
- collect 200 failing samples, crop to top 20 by severity
- block merge until we have regression PR with fix or rollback

samir: ack, will post ETA ~ 90m

harper: thx — we'll triage in 1pm sync if not resolved by then :thumbsup:
